nodes.label: QPG Improvement Plan
nodes.rationale: Order: fix bugs, then fix format, then go agentic — nothing else matters until active silent failures are stopped; explicitly lists what NOT to change: the two-LLM generator-validator pattern, Celery async architecture, DRF token auth, round-robin key management, and SQLite until concurrent write errors appear.

nodes.label: Global __HEADER_META__ Race Condition (Bug 1)
nodes.rationale: Under concurrent Celery workers, Paper A silently gets Paper B's class/time/marks in the Word header because generate_with_universal_prompt writes globals()['__HEADER_META__'] that render_docx reads; fix is passing header_meta as an explicit parameter.

nodes.label: MCQ Options Dropped in render_pdf (Bug 2)
nodes.rationale: render_pdf has no opts_block branch, so the 2x2 MCQ option table produced by render_section_questions is silently ignored — students receive unanswerable PDF papers.

nodes.label: Embedding Fallback Permanently Broken (Bug 3)
nodes.rationale: ollama_embed falls back to titan_embed, which unconditionally raises RuntimeError('bedrock-runtime is not accessible'), so any Ollama restart/timeout kills all generation; fix is graceful degradation — a zero vector (generation continues without RAG) or a domain-specific EmbeddingUnavailableError.

nodes.label: Teacher Instructions Stripped by normalize_blueprint (Bug 4)
nodes.rationale: passage_instruction, extract_instruction, instructions and constraints are stored correctly on ExamPattern.sections but silently discarded by normalize_blueprint before the LLM prompt is built — the LLM never sees them.

nodes.label: ExamPattern total_marks Drift (Bug 5)
nodes.rationale: No save() override recalculates the denormalised total_marks/total_questions, so after a section edit the LLM prompt includes the wrong total and generates a paper for the wrong mark total.

nodes.label: Semantic Deduplication Never Active (Bug 6)
nodes.rationale: check_question_similarity's collection.query call lacked include=['embeddings'], so results['embeddings'] was always falsy and similarity silently fell back to naive 70% word overlap every time — a one-word fix.

nodes.label: Phase 2 Format Fix (CBSE DOCX Rendering)
nodes.rationale: The LLM produces reasonable content that the renderer throws away — an 80% rendering problem, not a generation problem; covers school name from settings, Word header section, general instructions block, bordered passage boxes, right-aligned marks, OR horizontal rules, hard-coded AR options, page-number footers and explicit font sizes.

nodes.label: Phase 3 Agentic Pipeline (Orchestrator/Section/Validator)
nodes.rationale: A 200+ line single prompt degrades LLM attention and one truncation collapses the whole paper; per-section ~70-line prompts run in parallel (max 3 workers), failed sections retry individually, and the existing single-prompt path stays as automatic fallback until 50+ successful parallel generations in production.

nodes.label: SectionWorkOrder Dataclass
nodes.rationale: Carries one section's full generation spec (marks, counts, types, instructions) plus pre-fetched section-specific RAG context and an estimated output token budget — the unit of work for parallel generation.

nodes.label: RAG Improvements (Chunking/Metadata/bge-m3)
nodes.rationale: Replace fixed 800-char zero-overlap chunks with sentence-aware 512-token chunks with 75-token overlap (requires re-ingesting PDFs); add per-chunk metadata; upgrade the English-only 384d all-minilm embedder to multilingual 1024d BAAI/bge-m3 for Hindi NCERT.

nodes.label: estimate_token_budget (Dynamic max_tokens)
nodes.rationale: Replaces the hardcoded 4096 max_tokens that truncated complex papers; budget is computed from question counts and passage presence, capped at 8192.
